description: This file contains an implementation of the AES (Rijndael) cipher, supporting only 128-bit keys, with options for size optimization (AES_SMALL_TABLES). It includes functions for key expansion, encryption, and decryption, and defines lookup tables for the cipher's transformations.

methods.name: rijndaelKeySetupEnc
methods.description: Expands the cipher key into the encryption key schedule.

methods.name: rijndaelKeySetupDec
methods.description: Expands the cipher key into the decryption key schedule.

methods.name: rijndaelEncrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on a 16-byte plaintext block using the expanded key.

methods.name: rijndaelDecrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on a 16-byte ciphertext block using the expanded key.
